C01.title: Person protection and run epochs
C01.requiredDecision: Define old-run protection and explicit-new-run consent for scalar and structural conflicts.

C02.title: Structural run undo and adoption
C02.requiredDecision: Specify surviving ids, parents and placements for create/move/delete interleavings and list kept person items.

C03.title: Individual undo/redo and undo_change
C03.requiredDecision: Choose targets across interleaved agent commits, redo invalidation and refusal/skip recovery; forbid silent overwrites.

C04.title: Native kept flagged and source preservation
C04.requiredDecision: Classify features, absent kept preview, graph closure, uncompressed part identity, security removals, provenance and migration.

C05.title: Tool catalog and actor authority
C05.requiredDecision: Pin catalog and scope; no deck deletion, account or billing tools; separate trusted fixtures from public routes.

C06.title: Principal and ownership boundary
C06.requiredDecision: One trusted person/connection/run principal across access, files, history, assets and agent writes.

C07.title: Performance budgets and measurement
C07.requiredDecision: Adopt or explicitly revise every metric/rule in phase-data.json, including startup, render tolerance, worker and a separate PDF deadline. Record workload/limiter; never borrow import latency for models.

C08.title: Rendering and font tolerance
C08.requiredDecision: Pin font files/licenses, glyph/line metrics, viewports, fallback and visual thresholds before consumers.

C09.title: Email access and session policy
C09.requiredDecision: 15-minute single use, 30-second resend; choose resend invalidation, finite attempt/rate limits, session lifetime and revocation; choose wrong or expired code placement (inline on S22.01 per backlog.md versus page S29.01 per logic.md), its copy, retry and focus behavior.

C10.title: Home and first request design conflicts
C10.requiredDecision: Choose true-empty versus seeded Home, retire Starred, choose F02 entry point; pin copy and retained intent.

C11.title: Export and operation behavior
C11.requiredDecision: One saved version during active runs; cancellation/result expiry, import/export failure and offline Ask/Export waiting.

C12.title: Snapshot paging and response limits
C12.requiredDecision: Cursor snapshot lifetime, edits during paging, stale/expired cursor recovery, bounded output and capture metadata.

C13.title: Remote authorization and registration
C13.requiredDecision: Pin SDK/spec, audience/resource, PKCE, client-ID metadata/registration, refresh rotation/replay, revocation and 30-day idle expiry.

C14.title: Week identity timezone and DST
C14.requiredDecision: Monday 08:00 in stored timezone; choose effective week for timezone changes and DST, with no duplicate allowance/reset.

C15.title: Credits refunds and payment races
C15.requiredDecision: Bonus/paid order, minimum add/reset prices, one open payment, verified credit, cancel/paid race, chargeback floor and platform-failure refund.

C16.title: Retention and deletion
C16.requiredDecision: Freeze owned-data retention, 30-day Trash purge, result expiry and account/audit retention consequences; obtain provider/legal facts before activation.

C17.title: User Agent usage and automatic spending conflict
C17.requiredDecision: Resolve no User Agent credit debit versus auto-reset promises. Proposed default: User Agent cannot trigger credit spending and returns waiting/reset link; person-enabled Aira auto reset has the three/week cap. P07 must accept or explicitly replace this source-backed rule.

C18.title: Offline person edits and account isolation
C18.requiredDecision: Person edits land in arrival order over intervening agent values; define deleted-target restore, saved labels and principal-keyed queue clearance/isolation.

C19.title: Worker resource and security limits
C19.requiredDecision: Freeze ZIP/XML/font limits, CPU/memory/wall time, no renderer egress, per-owner/job temp isolation and crash/cancel cleanup.

C20.title: Quality and tool evaluation
C20.requiredDecision: Adopt branch family/task/human/judge thresholds and denominator rules; rerun subsequent schema/description changes; assign monthly human recalibration owner.

C21.title: Evidence and external gate boundaries
C21.requiredDecision: Local engine/tree/reference-client proofs may merge without fidelity/AT/vendor claims. Mandatory P09 X01-X06 and P09 claim checks cannot pass by proxy.

C22.title: Tokens accessibility and phone scope
C22.requiredDecision: shadcn variables, corrected contrast, two motion tokens, keyboard/focus/status/error behavior, reduced motion and 320 CSS px access/read-only deck viewing.

C23.title: Templates and image provenance
C23.requiredDecision: Immutable versions/originals, linked/local overrides, embedding rights, applied masters, crop/mask/alt export, owned dedup and refusals.

C24.title: Provider and public endpoint authorization
C24.requiredDecision: Pin sandbox/provider/FX and reconciliation; require endpoint/tunnel and paid-trial authorization. Missing services are X03/X05/X06 blockers, not fixture successes.
